sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将对部分采访进行直播，供所有人免费观看，网址是 nytimes.com。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约

sentences.en: Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the police shooting of Jacob Blake and the violent aftermath.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲的是雅各布·布莱克遭警察枪击及其引发的暴力后果。

sentences.en: My colleague, Julie Bosman, has been in Kenosha, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我的同事朱莉·博斯曼一直在威斯康星州基诺沙市。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月27日，星期四。

sentences.en: Julie, how did you first hear about this shooting?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，你是怎么第一次听说这次枪击事件的？

sentences.en: So on Sunday night, I was home in Chicago and a text popped up on my phone from a friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，我当时在芝加哥的家中，手机上弹出了一条朋友发来的短信。

sentences.en: And when I looked at the text, I saw that it was a link to a video about an incident that had happened in Kenosha, Wisconsin, my hometown.
sentences.zh: 当我查看短信时，发现里面是一个视频链接，内容是发生在我家乡威斯康星州基诺沙市的一起事件。

sentences.en: And this is a cell phone video that was taken from an apartment window.
sentences.zh: 这是一个从公寓窗户拍摄的手机视频。

sentences.en: And it's looking down on an altercation happening in the street involving a man that we will later learn is Jacob Blake.
sentences.zh: 视频俯瞰着街上发生的一场争执，涉及一名后来我们得知叫雅各布·布莱克的男子。

sentences.en: And what you can see in this video is an SUV.
sentences.zh: 在视频中，你可以看到一辆 SUV。

sentences.en: There are several officers standing on a sidewalk right next to it.
sentences.zh: 几名警察站在车旁的人行道上。

sentences.en: And Jacob Blake is seen walking along the passenger side of this SUV away from the officers who are yelling at him.
sentences.zh: 雅各布·布莱克沿着 SUV 的副驾驶一侧走开，警察在后面对他大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And at that point, at least one officer points a gun at Jacob Blake.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，至少有一名警察用枪指着雅各布·布莱克。

sentences.en: And Jacob Blake continues to walk around the front of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 雅各布·布莱克继续绕到车头。

sentences.en: He opens the driver's side door.
sentences.zh: 他打开了驾驶座一侧的车门。

sentences.en: And then one of the officers shoots him several times in the back.
sentences.zh: 随后，其中一名警察向他的背部开了几枪。

sentences.en: We later learned that he was taken to a hospital and that he survived the shooting.
sentences.zh: 我们后来得知他被送往医院，并在枪击中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: By late Sunday evening, there were marches, there were demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 到了周日深夜，出现了游行和示威活动。

sentences.en: And there was also unreSt. There were trucks that were burned.
sentences.zh: 同时也出现了动乱。有卡车被烧毁。

sentences.en: There were fires that were set.
sentences.zh: 有人纵火。

sentences.en: People were throwing things at the police.
sentences.zh: 人们向警察投掷物品。

sentences.en: It was a really tense scene.
sentences.zh: 现场气氛非常紧张。

sentences.en: And so what do you decide to do?
sentences.zh: 那么你决定怎么做？

sentences.en: So first thing the next morning, got in my car and drove north an hour and a half to Kenosha.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，我上了车，向北开了一个半小时来到基诺沙。

sentences.en: I first went to the neighborhood where Jacob Blake was shot.
sentences.zh: 我首先去了雅各布·布莱克被枪击的街区。

sentences.en: And what I found there were neighbors sitting outside, talking to each other, just dazed by what had happened, trying to piece together the shooting.
sentences.zh: 我在那里看到邻居们坐在外面交谈，他们对发生的事情感到震惊，正试图拼凑出枪击事件的经过。

sentences.en: And what did you learn from talking to them about what had happened?
sentences.zh: 你从与他们的交谈中了解到了什么？

sentences.en: It seemed like a lot of neighbors had seen Jacob just before.
sentences.zh: 似乎很多邻居在枪击发生前不久都见过雅各布。

sentences.en: They had seen him, you know, out on the front lawn barbecuing.
sentences.zh: 他们看到他，你知道，在前院烧烤。

sentences.en: They had seen him playing with his kids earlier that day.
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，他们还看到他和孩子们玩耍。

sentences.en: But just before the shooting, there had been some kind of disagreement between two people.
sentences.zh: 但在枪击发生前不久，两人之间发生了一些争执。

sentences.en: And that's when the police arrived on the scene.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，警察赶到了现场。

sentences.en: We know that the police were apparently summoned there to help.
sentences.zh: 我们知道警察显然是应召前来帮忙的。

sentences.en: And then we know what we saw in the video.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到了视频里的内容。

sentences.en: But it's not clear yet what exactly happened in the minutes leading up to it.
sentences.zh: 但目前还不清楚在那之前的几分钟里到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: So Julie, as you're talking to people and they're trying to make sense of this shooting that's happened in their neighborhood, what happens on Monday as the day unfolds?
sentences.zh: 那么朱莉，当你与人们交谈，而他们正试图理解发生在他们社区的这起枪击事件时，周一的情况如何？

sentences.en: The way that day kind of unfurled, it felt to me almost like one continuous proteSt. The protesting kind of never stopped.
sentences.zh: 那天的情况演变方式，给我的感觉几乎就像是一场持续不断的抗议。抗议似乎从未停止。

sentences.en: And by mid-afternoon on Monday, the mayor of Kenosha,
sentences.zh: 到了周一下午，基诺沙市市长，

sentences.en: John Interamian, had not yet made any public statement about what had happened in his city the night before.
sentences.zh: 约翰·安特拉米安，还没有就前一天晚上在他城市发生的事情发表任何公开声明。

sentences.en: So he stepped out.
sentences.zh: 于是他走了出来。

sentences.en: What I'm going to tell you is basically what we were talking about inside.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉你们的基本上就是我们在里面谈论的内容。

sentences.en: At one point, he tried to speak to protesters.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他试图与抗议者对话。

sentences.en: Kenosha has a history of trying to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 基诺沙一直有努力做正确之事的传统。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: And he was really drowned out by people who were just furious over what had happened.
sentences.zh: 但他真的被那些对所发生之事感到愤怒的人群淹没了。

sentences.en: And he tried to urge calm.
sentences.zh: 他试图呼吁冷静。

sentences.en: He, you know, tried to send people the message that he was listening.
sentences.zh: 他，你知道，试图向人们传达他在倾听的信息。

sentences.en: Because you weren't even willing to let me, who I came out, to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 因为你们甚至不愿让我，我出来是为了和你们谈谈。

sentences.en: You in a black light.
sentences.zh: 你们在黑光下。

sentences.en: You're not a black light.
sentences.zh: 你不是黑光。

sentences.en: But in the moment, it just didn't feel like enough.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，这似乎还不够。

sentences.en: And he went inside the building.
sentences.zh: 于是他走进了大楼。

sentences.en: So after the mayor goes back inside, what ends up happening?
sentences.zh: 那么在市长回到室内后，最终发生了什么？

sentences.en: So on Monday evening, I was covering a protest at the park outside of the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，我在报道法院外公园的一场抗议活动。

sentences.en: And what I saw were hundreds of people who were all chanting together
sentences.zh: 我看到数百人齐声高喊

sentences.en: Jacob Blake's name and confronting the police.
sentences.zh: 雅各布·布莱克的名字，并与警察对峙。

sentences.en: And at this point, this was just a very, very chill proteSt.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，这还只是一场非常、非常平静的抗议。

sentences.en: People were coming out of their houses and, you know, pumping their fists and honking their horns in agreement with the proteSt.
sentences.zh: 人们从家里出来，你知道，挥舞着拳头，按响喇叭以示支持抗议。

sentences.en: And at one point, an older couple came outside and had a little bullhorn.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一对年长的夫妇走出来，拿着一个小扩音器。

sentences.en: And they were chanting and cheering the protesters on.
sentences.zh: 他们高喊着口号，为抗议者加油。

sentences.en: But, you know, as the night wore on, a lot of people left and the mood of the crowd changed and it turned into a gathering with a much more destructive edge.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，随着夜色渐深，许多人离开了，人群的情绪发生了变化，变成了一场带有更多破坏性色彩的集会。

sentences.en: On Sheridan Road, people were starting fires and there are these kind of old street lamps.
sentences.zh: 在谢里登路上，人们开始纵火，那里有一些老式路灯。

sentences.en: And people were knocking over the street lamps so that they smashed into the street.
sentences.zh: 人们把路灯撞倒，使其砸在街道上。

sentences.en: They were throwing fireworks at the police, who at this point had been joined by National Guardsmen.
sentences.zh: 他们向警察投掷烟花，此时国民警卫队也已加入警察行列。

sentences.en: And the police and the National Guard were trying to disperse the protesters without a lot of luck.
sentences.zh: 警察和国民警卫队试图驱散抗议者，但收效甚微。

sentences.en: This went on for hours.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了几个小时。

sentences.en: And close to midnight, I had gotten back in my car.
sentences.zh: 接近午夜时，我回到了车里。

sentences.en: I was driving through the streets and I saw huge, billowing, pink-tinged smoke in the distance.
sentences.zh: 我开车穿过街道，看到远处有巨大的、泛着粉红色的浓烟滚滚而来。

sentences.en: And it honestly took me a minute just to process what was happening because I was driving in such a familiar place, a street that I have driven on hundreds of times in my life.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我花了一分钟才反应过来发生了什么，因为我行驶在一个如此熟悉的地方，一条我一生中走过数百次的街道。

sentences.en: And as I pulled up, parked the car and stepped outside, what I saw was an entire block on fire in the middle of a residential neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 当我把车停好走出来时，我看到整个街区都在燃烧，就在住宅区中间。

sentences.en: And I could see that neighbors were everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我可以看到邻居们到处都是。

sentences.en: They had brought their children out onto their front porches.
sentences.zh: 他们把孩子带到了前廊上。

sentences.en: They were standing in the middle of the street on the sidewalks, just staring.
sentences.zh: 他们站在街道中间和人行道上，只是盯着看。

sentences.en: And when I started talking to people, I discovered that their reactions were really complicated.
sentences.zh: 当我开始与人们交谈时，我发现他们的反应真的很复杂。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: So some people said, oh my God, this is horrible.
sentences.zh: 有些人说，天哪，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: This is our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的社区。

sentences.en: Our neighborhood is burning.
sentences.zh: 我们的社区正在燃烧。

sentences.en: What is happening to our city?
sentences.zh: 我们的城市发生了什么？

sentences.en: They told me what businesses were there, that it was a mattress store, that it was a Mexican restaurant.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我那里有哪些商店，说那是一家床垫店，那是一家墨西哥餐馆。

sentences.en: Someone told me that, you know, it was the little kind of cafe where he got his coffee every morning.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，你知道，那是他每天早上买咖啡的小咖啡馆。

sentences.en: And then a lot of people said, look, this is a totally appropriate response to what happened to Jacob Blake.
sentences.zh: 然后很多人说，看，这是对雅各布·布莱克遭遇的完全恰当的回应。

sentences.en: Like, this is a totally appropriate response to the oppression of the Black community in this city and in this country.
sentences.zh: 就像，这是对这个城市和这个国家黑人社区所受压迫的完全恰当的回应。

sentences.en: Like, I talked to a man who was standing there smoking a cigarette and just said, look, I'm really sorry to see this.
sentences.zh: 比如，我和一个站在那里抽烟的男人谈过，他只是说，看，看到这一幕我真的很遗憾。

sentences.en: But, like, if this is what it takes, then this is what it takes.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果这是必须付出的代价，那就这样吧。

sentences.en: And then I got back in my car and I called the Kenosha County Sheriff.
sentences.zh: 然后我回到车里，给基诺沙县警长打了电话。

sentences.en: And he said, basically, we're just outnumbered.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，我们只是寡不敌众。

sentences.en: We only have about 200 police officers.
sentences.zh: 我们只有大约200名警察。

sentences.en: And he said, we have National Guard, but we don't have enough National Guardsmen.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们有国民警卫队，但国民警卫队员不够。

sentences.en: And, you know, we've got 911 calls pouring in all night.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，整晚都有911报警电话涌入。

sentences.en: And, you know, we just kind of get there too late.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们赶到时总是太晚了。

sentences.en: So, I realized that tomorrow was probably also going to be a long day.
sentences.zh: 所以我意识到明天可能又会是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: So, I decided it was just time to get home.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定是时候回家了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app, unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序，解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Julie, what happens on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 那么朱莉，周二发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, on Tuesday afternoon, Jacob Blake's family announced that they were going to hold a news conference outside of the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 周二下午，雅各布·布莱克的家人宣布他们将在法院外举行新闻发布会。

sentences.en: So, around 3 p.m., I'm outside of the courthouse with a bunch of other reporters, long line of TV cameras, and the family of Jacob Blake arrives.
sentences.zh: 大约下午3点，我和其他许多记者站在法院外，那里排着长长的电视摄像机队伍，雅各布·布莱克的家人到了。

sentences.en: Some of them were crying, clutching each other, you know, obviously very emotional.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人在哭泣，互相拥抱，你知道，显然非常激动。

sentences.en: I'd like to thank everyone for coming out in support of my son with this senseless attempted murder that was committed on him.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢大家出来支持我的儿子，支持他所遭受的这起毫无意义的谋杀未遂事件。

sentences.en: When Jacob Blake Sr.
sentences.zh: 当雅各布·布莱克老先生

sentences.en: stepped forward, they shot my son, he almost couldn't speak.
sentences.zh: 走上前时，他们向我儿子开了枪，他几乎说不出话来。

sentences.en: Seven times?
sentences.zh: 七枪？

sentences.en: Seven times.
sentences.zh: 七枪。

sentences.en: Like he didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 就像他无关紧要一样。

sentences.en: But my son matters.
sentences.zh: 但我儿子很重要。

sentences.en: He's a human being, and he matters.
sentences.zh: 他是一个人，他很重要。

sentences.en: And then we heard from Julia Jackson, Jacob Blake's mother.
sentences.zh: 然后我们听到了雅各布·布莱克的母亲朱莉娅·杰克逊的发言。

sentences.en: As I was riding through here, through the city, I noticed a lot of damage.
sentences.zh: 当我穿过这里，穿过这座城市时，我注意到有很多破坏。

sentences.en: It doesn't reflect my son or my family.
sentences.zh: 这并不代表我的儿子或我的家人。

sentences.en: She mentioned the damage that she had been seeing around Kenosha, and she spoke very powerfully of reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 她提到了她在基诺沙各地看到的破坏，并非常有力地谈到了和解。

sentences.en: Do Jacob justice on this level, and examine your hearts.
sentences.zh: 在这个层面上为雅各布伸张正义，审视你们的内心。

sentences.en: We need healing.
sentences.zh: 我们需要治愈。

sentences.en: And then we heard from one of his sisters.
sentences.zh: 然后我们听到了他的一位姐妹的发言。

sentences.en: So many people have reached out to me, telling me they're sorry that this happened to my family.
sentences.zh: 有很多人联系我，告诉我他们为发生在我家人身上的事感到抱歉。

sentences.en: Well, don't be sorry, because this has been happening to my family for a long time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，不要抱歉，因为这种事长期以来一直发生在我家人身上。

sentences.en: Longer than I can account for.
sentences.zh: 比我能记起的还要久。

sentences.en: It happened to Emmett Till.
sentences.zh: 埃米特·蒂尔身上发生过。

sentences.en: Emmett Till is my family.
sentences.zh: 埃米特·蒂尔是我的家人。

sentences.en: Philando, Mike Brown, Sandra.
sentences.zh: 菲兰多、迈克·布朗、桑德拉。

sentences.en: This has been happening to my family.
sentences.zh: 这种事一直发生在我家人身上。

sentences.en: And I've shared tears for every single one of these people that it's happened to.
sentences.zh: 我为每一个遭遇这种事的人流过泪。

sentences.en: This is nothing new.
sentences.zh: 这没什么新鲜的。

sentences.en: I'm not sad.
sentences.zh: 我不难过。

sentences.en: I'm not sorry.
sentences.zh: 我不抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm angry.
sentences.zh: 我很愤怒。

sentences.en: And I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 而且我累了。

sentences.en: I think that she just really wanted people to hear that and understand that this was bigger than her brother.
sentences.zh: 我想她只是真的想让人们听到并理解，这件事比她哥哥个人的遭遇要大得多。

sentences.en: And what did the family say about Jacob Blake's condition?
sentences.zh: 家人对雅各布·布莱克的状况说了什么？

sentences.en: You know, for the last two days, people had been asking, how is he doing?
sentences.zh: 你知道，过去两天里，人们一直在问，他怎么样了？

sentences.en: Is he going to survive this?
sentences.zh: 他能活下来吗？

sentences.en: When at least seven, as many as eight bullets from point blank range enter the human body and shred through the tissue of the human body?
sentences.zh: 当至少七发、多达八发子弹从近距离射入人体并撕裂人体组织时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: They went into a lot of detail about what he was experiencing physically.
sentences.zh: 他们非常详细地描述了他身体上所经历的一切。

sentences.en: That that can cause, and did in this case, severe and likely permanent injury.
sentences.zh: 那会导致，而且在本案中确实导致了严重且很可能是永久性的伤害。

sentences.en: He had a bullet go through some or all of his spinal cord.
sentences.zh: 有一颗子弹穿过了他的部分或全部脊髓。

sentences.en: One of the bullets had severed his spinal cord, which doctors believed would paralyze him partially, probably permanently.
sentences.zh: 其中一颗子弹切断了他的脊髓，医生认为这会导致他部分瘫痪，而且很可能是永久性的。

sentences.en: They said that it would take a miracle for him to walk again.
sentences.zh: 他们说他能再次行走简直是奇迹。

sentences.en: He has holes in his stomach.
sentences.zh: 他的胃部有弹孔。

sentences.en: He had to have nearly his entire colon and small intestines removed.
sentences.zh: 他几乎切除了整个结肠和小肠。

sentences.en: They really wanted to drive home the physicality of that, of the suffering that he is enduring.
sentences.zh: 他们确实想强调这种身体上的创伤，以及他正在承受的痛苦。

sentences.en: And they wanted to really put those facts out there and not hide them.
sentences.zh: 他们想把这些事实公之于众，而不是隐瞒。

sentences.en: Jacob has a long road ahead of him.
sentences.zh: 雅各布前方的路还很长。

sentences.en: A lot of rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 需要大量的康复治疗。

sentences.en: You heard he's in surgery right now, and it is not going to be his laSt...
sentences.zh: 你听说他现在正在手术中，而且这不会是他的最后一次……

sentences.en: They also said that he has been awake.
sentences.zh: 他们还说他已经醒了。

sentences.en: He was conscious.
sentences.zh: 他有意识。

sentences.en: One of the questions from reporters was, what does he think of all of this?
sentences.zh: 记者提出的问题之一是，他对此有何感想？

sentences.en: He does not know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 他不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: The answer from the family was really, he doesn't understand that this is going on.
sentences.zh: 家人的回答确实是，他并不明白这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: He's heavily medicated.
sentences.zh: 他服用了大量的药物。

sentences.en: He's, you know, in a lot of pain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他非常痛苦。

sentences.en: That he was still fighting for his life.
sentences.zh: 他仍在为生命而战。

sentences.en: So he has no idea, in the condition he's in, that he has become a symbol.
sentences.zh: 所以以他现在的状况，他根本不知道自己已经成为了一个象征。

sentences.en: A very powerful symbol.
sentences.zh: 一个非常有影响力的象征。

sentences.en: Yeah, it appears not.
sentences.zh: 是的，看起来并没有。

sentences.en: It appears that he is largely unaware of everything that's happening.
sentences.zh: 看起来他基本上对所发生的一切一无所知。

sentences.en: The first thing he did when he looked at me was cry, and then begin to say, I'm sorry about all of this.
sentences.zh: 他看着我时做的第一件事就是哭，然后开始说，我很抱歉这一切。

sentences.en: I asked him, Jacob, did you shoot yourself in the back?
sentences.zh: 我问他，雅各布，是你自己背部中枪的吗？

sentences.en: He looked at me, and he said, you know.
sentences.zh: 他看着我，说，你知道的。

sentences.en: I said, then, why are you sorry?
sentences.zh: 我说，那么，你为什么要道歉？

sentences.en: He says, because I don't want a burden on anybody.
sentences.zh: 他说，因为我不想成为任何人的负担。

sentences.en: I want to be with my children.
sentences.zh: 我想和我的孩子们在一起。

sentences.en: And I don't think I'm going to walk again, Mom.
sentences.zh: 而且妈妈，我觉得我再也站不起来了。

sentences.en: So I left that news conference and prepared for the evening ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以我离开了那场新闻发布会，为接下来的夜晚做准备。

sentences.en: I grew up here, and I've never seen so many people in the downtown area at one time.
sentences.zh: 我在这里长大，从未见过市中心一次性聚集这么多人。

sentences.en: And the evening began with a lot of gatherings near the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 夜晚在法院附近的大量集会中开始。

sentences.en: This is really kind of the heart of where all the protests have been happening in Kenosha.
sentences.zh: 这确实是基诺沙所有抗议活动的核心地带。

sentences.en: A lot of the protest leaders were talking to the crowds and saying, this is a night that we want things to be peaceful.
sentences.zh: 许多抗议领袖在对人群讲话，说，今晚我们希望一切和平进行。

sentences.en: Let's focus on why we're all here.
sentences.zh: 让我们专注于我们为什么来到这里。

sentences.en: And around 8 o'clock, everyone's phones started screeching.
sentences.zh: 大约8点钟，每个人的手机都开始发出刺耳的警报声。

sentences.en: If you continue to stay here, that results in an unlawful assembly.
sentences.zh: 如果你继续留在这里，将导致非法集会。

sentences.en: And it was an emergency alert from the city, warning everyone that there was a curfew in effect, and they were required to go home.
sentences.zh: 这是来自市政府的紧急警报，警告大家宵禁已经生效，要求所有人回家。

sentences.en: We are asking that you please go home.
sentences.zh: 我们请求大家请回家。

sentences.en: A lot of people did peel off at that point.
sentences.zh: 当时很多人确实离开了。

sentences.en: But about 150 people remained in the park.
sentences.zh: 但仍有约150人留在公园里。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on, and it's sort of surreal, actually.
sentences.zh: 这里发生了很多事，实际上感觉有点超现实。

sentences.en: This evening felt a little different.
sentences.zh: 今晚感觉有点不同。

sentences.en: It felt much more tense.
sentences.zh: 感觉紧张得多。

sentences.en: Tonight, it feels rather lawless.
sentences.zh: 今晚，感觉相当无法无天。

sentences.en: There are people riding motorcycles around on the square.
sentences.zh: 有人在广场上骑摩托车。

sentences.en: There are armored vehicles driving over the square.
sentences.zh: 有装甲车在广场上行驶。

sentences.en: And people have long guns that they're holding openly.
sentences.zh: 还有人公开持有长枪。

sentences.en: There were a couple of guys who had come to the park who were decked out in camo.
sentences.zh: 有几个来到公园的人穿着迷彩服。

sentences.en: Flack jackets.
sentences.zh: 防弹背心。

sentences.en: And they were carrying long guns.
sentences.zh: 他们携带着长枪。

sentences.en: And when I went to talk to them, they told me that they were part of a Facebook group that had started that day,
sentences.zh: 当我去找他们谈话时，他们告诉我，他们是当天成立的一个Facebook群组的成员，

sentences.en: which was a group of mostly men who had decided that they were going to defend their city that night.
sentences.zh: 那是一个主要由男性组成的团体，他们决定当晚要保卫自己的城市。

sentences.en: That they were sick of watching what had happened on their phones from their homes.
sentences.zh: 他们厌倦了在家里通过手机看着所发生的一切。

sentences.en: They were sick of, you know, being afraid of fires and destruction.
sentences.zh: 他们厌倦了，你知道，对火灾和破坏感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And they were going to come out.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要出来。

sentences.en: And they had chosen to meet up in the very place where the protesters were.
sentences.zh: 他们选择在抗议者所在的同一个地方集合。

sentences.en: They told me that they were not opposed to the Black Lives Matter movement, that they respected the right of the protesters to be there.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，他们并不反对“黑人的命也是命”运动，他们尊重抗议者在那里抗议的权利。

sentences.en: But they felt that the BLM movement had been hijacked by agitators from the outside.
sentences.zh: 但他们觉得BLM运动被外来的煽动者劫持了。

sentences.en: And Julie, what did it mean to them, as best you could tell, to defend their city?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，据你所知，保卫城市对他们意味着什么？

sentences.en: They were just very simply going to divide up, stand on street corners, stand there with guns, and use them if necessary.
sentences.zh: 他们只是简单地打算分组，站在街角，拿着枪站在那里，必要时使用它们。

sentences.en: They just said, look, if the police aren't going to protect us, then we'll protect ourselves.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，看，如果警察不保护我们，那我们就自己保护自己。

sentences.en: So at this point, you have protesters on the street because of this police shooting.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，因为这次警察枪击事件，街上有抗议者。

sentences.en: And now you have citizens with guns acting like police officers in their minds to protect the community.
sentences.zh: 而现在，在你面前的是一些带着枪的公民，在他们心中，他们像警察一样在保护社区。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, as you can imagine, it's a very volatile mix.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可以想象，这是一个非常不稳定的组合。

sentences.en: And as we, you know, proceeded through the night.
sentences.zh: 随着我们，你知道，度过这个夜晚。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday night, about 930.
sentences.zh: 现在是周二晚上，大约9点半。

sentences.en: And for close to an hour now, excuse me, we've been in a bit of a standoff with police and demonstrators facing off against each other.
sentences.zh: 近一个小时以来，抱歉，我们一直处于警察和示威者对峙的状态。

sentences.en: A lot of people who had remained were throwing water bottles and engaging with the police in a sometimes violent way.
sentences.zh: 许多留下的人在投掷水瓶，并以有时暴力的方式与警察发生冲突。

sentences.en: And the protesters have been throwing lit fireworks at the police.
sentences.zh: 抗议者一直在向警察投掷点燃的烟花。

sentences.en: And the police have now began to respond with quite a bit of tear gas and with rubber bullets.
sentences.zh: 警察现在已经开始用大量的催泪瓦斯和橡胶子弹进行回应。

sentences.en: For hours, this back and forth continued of people in the crowd throwing things at the police.
sentences.zh: 几个小时来，人群向警察投掷物品的拉锯战持续不断。

sentences.en: Sending live fireworks that way, the fireworks exploding right next to the police officers who were all in riot gear and shields.
sentences.zh: 向那个方向发射实弹烟花，烟花在全副防暴装备和盾牌的警察身边爆炸。

sentences.en: And the police finally responded with enough tear gas, like a pretty overwhelming amount of tear gas on the crowd that finally pushed everyone out of the park.
sentences.zh: 警察最终用足够多的催泪瓦斯，即压倒性的催泪瓦斯回应人群，最终将所有人赶出了公园。

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: And what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: What happened next is that the crowd did begin to disperse a bit.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的是人群确实开始散去了一些。

sentences.en: And I ended up joining some of the people who had remained in the crowd further down the street where they had started to gather at this gas station.
sentences.zh: 我最终加入了留在人群中的一些人，他们沿着街道走到了他们开始聚集的那个加油站。

sentences.en: There were these groups of white men in militia gear.
sentences.zh: 那里有一些穿着民兵装备的白人男子。

sentences.en: They were holding long guns and they were confronting the people in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着长枪，正在与人群中的人对峙。

sentences.en: Sometimes there was some shoving, they were yelling at each other, they were circling each other.
sentences.zh: 有时会有一些推搡，他们互相叫喊，互相盘旋。

sentences.en: And at one point, a white man yelled at a black man and basically dared him to shoot at him using a racial slur.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一个白人男子对一个黑人男子大喊大叫，基本上用种族歧视的语言挑衅他开枪。

sentences.en: It felt like the situation was a little out of control.
sentences.zh: 感觉局势有点失控了。

sentences.en: So I decided to get in my car and leave.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定上车离开。

sentences.en: And it was just a short while later, less than a half hour later, when I had started watching the live streams on Facebook and saw that there were reports of a shooting.
sentences.zh: 就在不久之后，不到半小时，我开始观看Facebook上的直播，看到有枪击事件的报道。

sentences.en: You see the man running down the street.
sentences.zh: 你看到那个人沿着街道跑。

sentences.en: This is after he allegedly shot someone in the stomach at a gas station.
sentences.zh: 这是在他据称在加油站向某人腹部开枪之后。

sentences.en: He's walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 他正走在街上。

sentences.en: Very, very close to that gas station on that same street.
sentences.zh: 离那条街上的加油站非常非常近。

sentences.en: And it looked from the videos that it was involving the same people.
sentences.zh: 从视频上看，这涉及的是同一群人。

sentences.en: And then what transpires is you see him firing at people as they are coming up.
sentences.zh: 然后发生的事情是，你看到他向走过来的人开火。

sentences.en: And what appears to be trying to grab him, to stop him.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们试图抓住他，阻止他。

sentences.en: You see one person fall on the ground.
sentences.zh: 你看到一个人倒在地上。

sentences.en: You see another gunshot go off.
sentences.zh: 你听到另一声枪响。

sentences.en: You can hear a lot of yelling.
sentences.zh: 你可以听到很多叫喊声。

sentences.en: Julie, what do we know about this shooting?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，关于这次枪击事件我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: And do we know who did the shooting?
sentences.zh: 我们知道是谁开的枪吗？

sentences.en: So what we know so far is that three people were shot.
sentences.zh: 目前我们所知道的是，有三个人中枪。

sentences.en: Two of those people died.
sentences.zh: 其中两人死亡。

sentences.en: We also know that police have now arrested a teenager they believe is a shooter.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道，警方现在已经逮捕了一名他们认为是枪手的少年。

sentences.en: And he's a 17-year-old white male from Antioch, Illinois, which is just across the state border.
sentences.zh: 他是一名来自伊利诺伊州安提阿的17岁白人男性，那里就在州界对面。

sentences.en: And we don't know why he was there, but authorities say that they are investigating whether he was a member of a vigilante group.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他为什么在那里，但当局表示他们正在调查他是否是一个治安维持组织的成员。

sentences.en: And his social media accounts appear to show an intense affinity for guns, for law enforcement, and for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他的社交媒体账户似乎显示出对枪支、执法部门和特朗普总统的强烈偏好。

sentences.en: Julie, I'm mindful that Jacob Blake's mother had implored the community to have peaceful protests.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，我记得雅各布·布莱克的母亲曾恳求社区进行和平抗议。

sentences.en: She seemed very upset by the destruction.
sentences.zh: 她似乎对破坏行为感到非常不安。

sentences.en: And now, of course, it's not just destruction.
sentences.zh: 而现在，当然，不仅仅是破坏了。

sentences.en: There have been two deaths.
sentences.zh: 已经有两人死亡。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think that, you know, what happened on Tuesday night was incredibly tragic.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为，你知道，周二晚上发生的事情极其悲惨。

sentences.en: For a lot of people, it compounds the tragedy of what happened on Sunday to Jacob Blake.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，这加剧了周日雅各布·布莱克所遭遇的悲剧。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people are just grappling with how to move forward with these demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多人都在努力思考如何继续这些示威活动。

sentences.en: There's a lot of worry right now in Kenosha among people who've been out here night after night, who've been trying to bring attention to the issue of police brutality.
sentences.zh: 基诺沙现在有很多担忧，在那些夜复一夜来到这里，试图引起人们对警察暴行问题的关注的人们中间。

sentences.en: How does this change the debate?
sentences.zh: 这如何改变了辩论？

sentences.en: How is it going to be manipulated politically?
sentences.zh: 它将如何在政治上被操纵？

sentences.en: You have the Republican National Convention happening this week.
sentences.zh: 本周正在举行共和党全国代表大会。

sentences.en: President Trump said that he was going to send in federal troops to Kenosha.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统说他要向基诺沙派遣联邦军队。

sentences.en: The governor of the state said that he was going to send 500 additional National Guardsmen.
sentences.zh: 该州州长说他要派遣500名额外的国民警卫队员。

sentences.en: Does all of this muddy the message somehow?
sentences.zh: 这一切是否在某种程度上混淆了信息？

sentences.en: And I think that's one thing that a lot of people here are grappling with at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是这里许多人目前正在努力解决的一个问题。

sentences.en: Julie, you're talking about the message that will emerge from Kenosha.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，你谈到了将从基诺沙传出的信息。

sentences.en: And it strikes me that one of the things that's different in this case, regardless of what images come to dominate how people see what's happened there,
sentences.zh: 让我印象深刻的是，无论什么样的画面最终主导了人们对那里所发生事情的看法，这个案件中有一点是不同的，

sentences.en: is that the person at the center of this case is still alive.
sentences.zh: 那就是案件的核心人物还活着。

sentences.en: He's sitting in a hospital.
sentences.zh: 他正坐在医院里。

sentences.en: And while he may not understand what he represents to the world, presumably he will eventually understand it.
sentences.zh: 虽然他可能不明白自己对世界意味着什么，但想必他最终会明白的。

sentences.en: And he will be drawn into the way that this story is being told.
sentences.zh: 他将被卷入这个故事的讲述方式中。

sentences.en: He will be told he will talk about it.
sentences.zh: 他会被告知，他会谈论它。

sentences.en: And so he will be a living symbol, unlike George Floyd, unlike Breonna Taylor, unlike Rayshard Brooks.
sentences.zh: 所以他将成为一个活着的象征，不像乔治·弗洛伊德，不像布里安娜·泰勒，不像雷沙德·布鲁克斯。

sentences.en: I think that's one of the things that makes this so unique.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是让这件事如此独特的原因之一。

sentences.en: This whole week, the city of Kenosha has been turned inside out over this shooting.
sentences.zh: 整个这一周，基诺沙市因为这次枪击事件而天翻地覆。

sentences.en: But we have not yet heard from the man who is, like you said, in a hospital bed.
sentences.zh: 但我们还没有听到那个像你所说的那样躺在病床上的男人的声音。

sentences.en: And we don't know yet what he thinks about all of this.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道他对这一切有何看法。

sentences.en: We don't know yet what he has to say about it, how he'll choose to participate in it.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道他对此有何话要说，他将如何选择参与其中。

sentences.en: And in the end, it will be his story to tell.
sentences.zh: 最终，这将是他自己的故事。

sentences.en: Julie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the Wisconsin Department of Justice offered new details about the shooting of Jacob Blake.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，威斯康星州司法部提供了关于雅各布·布莱克枪击事件的新细节。

sentences.en: It's said that police were summoned to his block based on a call from a woman who was not identified, reporting that her boyfriend was not supposed to be on the premises.
sentences.zh: 据称，警方是接到一名未透露姓名的女子的报警电话后被传唤到他所在的街区的，该女子报告说她的男友不应该出现在该处。

sentences.en: During the encounter that followed, the statement said, police fired a taser at Blake while trying to subdue him, but failed to stop him.
sentences.zh: 声明称，在随后的遭遇中，警方在试图制服布莱克时向他发射了泰瑟枪，但未能阻止他。

sentences.en: It was then, as Blake walked to the driver's side door of his car, opened it, and leaned in, that an officer shot him seven times.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，当布莱克走向他汽车的驾驶座车门，打开车门并探身进去时，一名警官向他开了七枪。

sentences.en: At some point, the statement said, Blake told police he had a knife in his possession, which was eventually recovered from inside his car.
sentences.zh: 声明称，在某个时刻，布莱克告诉警察他身上有一把刀，这把刀最终从他的车内被找到。

sentences.en: What role, if any, that a knife played in the shooting remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 这把刀在枪击事件中是否起到了作用，目前尚不清楚。

sentences.en: Later on Wednesday night, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三晚些时候，美国

sentences.en: Department of Justice said that it would open a federal civil rights investigation into Blake's shooting.
sentences.zh: 司法部表示将对布莱克枪击事件展开联邦民权调查。

sentences.en: Meantime, athletes from the NBA, WNBA, Major League Baseball, and Major League Soccer all boycotted games on Wednesday in response to Blake's shooting.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，来自NBA、WNBA、美国职业棒球大联盟和美国职业足球大联盟的运动员们在周三集体抵制比赛，以回应布莱克的枪击事件。

sentences.en: The NBA walkout was organized by the Milwaukee Bucks of Wisconsin in a move that stunned the league.
sentences.zh: NBA的罢赛是由威斯康星州的密尔沃基雄鹿队组织的，此举震惊了整个联盟。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: So, look, this is a very serious storm.
sentences.zh: 听着，这是一场非常严重的风暴。

sentences.en: In the five years I've been governor, I don't believe I've had a press conference where it was my intention to convey the sense of urgency that I am trying to convey right now.
sentences.zh: 在我担任州长的五年里，我想我从未召开过像现在这样，旨在传达如此紧迫感的发布会。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, Hurricane Laura, a major Category 4 storm, was headed for the coasts of Louisiana and Texas, prompting dire warnings from state leaders.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，四级飓风“劳拉”正向路易斯安那州和得克萨斯州海岸逼近，促使州领导人发出了严厉警告。

sentences.en: And understand our state hasn't seen a storm surge like this in many, many decades.
sentences.zh: 你们要明白，我们州已经几十年没有见过这样的风暴潮了。

sentences.en: The National Hurricane Center said that the storm has sustained winds of up to 150 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 国家飓风中心表示，这场风暴的持续风速高达每小时150英里。

sentences.en: And could deliver, quote, unsurvivable storm surges that could reach 40 miles inland.
sentences.zh: 并可能带来所谓的“无法生存”的风暴潮，其影响范围可能深入内陆40英里。

sentences.en: It is expected to make landfall early this morning.
sentences.zh: 预计它将于今天清晨登陆。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: The violence must stop, whether in Minneapolis, Portland, or Kenosha.
sentences.zh: 暴力必须停止，无论是在明尼阿波利斯、波特兰还是基诺沙。

sentences.en: Too many heroes have died defending our freedom to see Americans strike each other down.
sentences.zh: 太多的英雄为了捍卫我们的自由而牺牲，我们不能眼睁睁看着美国人自相残杀。

sentences.en: On the third night of the Republican National Convention,
sentences.zh: 在共和党全国代表大会的第三个晚上，

sentences.en: Vice President Mike Pence denounced this summer's violent unrest in America's cities and cast himself and President Trump as firm allies of the police.
sentences.zh: 副总统迈克·彭斯谴责了今年夏天美国城市中的暴力骚乱，并将自己和特朗普总统塑造成警察的坚定盟友。

sentences.en: We will have law and order on the streets of this country for every American of every race and creed and color.
sentences.zh: 我们将为这个国家的每一位美国人，无论其种族、信仰和肤色，维护街头的法律与秩序。

sentences.en: In his speech, Pence framed the election as a choice about the kind of country and economy that America will become once the pandemic is over.
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，彭斯将这次选举描述为关于疫情结束后美国将成为什么样的国家和经济体的一种选择。

sentences.en: On November 3rd, you need to ask yourself, who do you trust to rebuild this economy?
sentences.zh: 在11月3日，你需要问问自己，你信任谁来重建这个经济？

sentences.en: A career politician who presided over the slowest economic recovery since the Great Depression?
sentences.zh: 是一位主持了自大萧条以来最缓慢经济复苏的职业政客？

sentences.en: Or a proven leader who created the greatest economy in the world?
sentences.zh: 还是一位创造了世界最伟大经济体的久经考验的领导人？

sentences.en: The choice is clear.
sentences.zh: 选择显而易见。

sentences.en: To bring America all the way back, we need four more years of President Donald Trump in the White House.
sentences.zh: 为了让美国全面复苏，我们需要唐纳德·特朗普总统在白宫再干四年。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我是莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台收听。
